description: Positive-control scan: established yeast TF motifs versus the WOPR structure-derived consensus in the identical pipeline
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, re, os, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# ---------- load genome + genes (same pipeline as the WOPR scan) ----------
fa=pd.read_csv("https://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/current_fasta/saccharomyces_cerevisiae/dna/Saccharomyces_cerevisiae.R64-1-1.dna.toplevel.fa.gz",
               sep="\x01",header=None,compression="gzip",names=["l"],dtype=str,quoting=3).l.tolist()
genome={}; cur=None; buf=[]
for line in fa:
    if line.startswith(">"):
        if cur: genome[cur]="".join(buf)
        cur=line[1:].split()[0]; buf=[]
    else: buf.append(line.strip().upper())
genome[cur]="".join(buf)
CH=[c for c in genome if c!="Mito"]
gtf=pd.read_csv("https://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-115/gtf/saccharomyces_cerevisiae/Saccharomyces_cerevisiae.R64-1-1.115.gtf.gz",
                sep="\t",comment="#",header=None,compression="gzip",
                names=["chrom","src","feat","start","end","score","strand","frame","attr"],dtype={"chrom":str})
g=gtf[gtf.feat=="gene"].copy()
g["gene_id"]=g.attr.str.extract(r'gene_id "([^"]+)"'); g["gene_name"]=g.attr.str.extract(r'gene_name "([^"]+)"')
g["biotype"]=g.attr.str.extract(r'gene_biotype "([^"]+)"'); g["name"]=g.gene_name.fillna(g.gene_id)
g=g[(g.biotype=="protein_coding")&(g.chrom.isin(CH))].reset_index(drop=True)
def rc(s): return s.translate(str.maketrans("ACGTN","TGCAN"))[::-1]
UP=700
P=pd.DataFrame([dict(gene_id=r.gene_id,name=r.name,
                     seq=(genome[r.chrom][max(0,r.start-1-UP):r.start-1] if r.strand=="+"
                          else rc(genome[r.chrom][r.end:min(len(genome[r.chrom]),r.end+UP)])))
                for r in g.itertuples()])
nuc="".join(genome[c] for c in CH)

MAP=np.full(256,-1,dtype=np.int64)
for i,b in enumerate("ACGT"): MAP[ord(b)]=i
def enc(s): return MAP[np.frombuffer(s.encode(),dtype=np.uint8)]
def kcounts(code,k):
    n=len(code)-k+1; idx=np.zeros(n,dtype=np.int64); ok=np.ones(n,dtype=bool)
    for i in range(k):
        c=code[i:i+n]; ok&=c>=0; idx=idx*4+np.where(c>=0,c,0)
    return np.bincount(idx[ok],minlength=4**k)
NUC=enc(nuc); KC={k:kcounts(NUC,k) for k in range(1,5)}
def widx(w):
    v=0
    for c in w: v=v*4+"ACGT".index(c)
    return v
def p_markov3(word):
    num=KC[4]; den=KC[3]
    p=den[widx(word[:3])]/den.sum()
    for i in range(len(word)-3):
        d=den[widx(word[i:i+3])]
        p*= num[widx(word[i:i+4])]/d if d else 0.0
    return p

IUP={"A":"A","C":"C","G":"G","T":"T","W":"AT","S":"CG","R":"AG","Y":"CT","M":"AC","K":"GT","N":"ACGT"}
def expand(m):
    out=[""]
    for c in m: out=[o+b for o in out for b in IUP[c]]
    return out
def regex(m): return "".join(c if c in "ACGT" else "["+IUP[c]+"]" for c in m)
def scan(m):
    """observed in genome and promoters (both strands) + Markov-3 expectation"""
    rxf=regex(m); rxr=regex("".join({"A":"T","T":"A","G":"C","C":"G","W":"W","S":"S","R":"Y","Y":"R","M":"K","K":"M","N":"N"}[c] for c in reversed(m)))
    og=len(re.findall("(?=%s)"%rxf,nuc))+len(re.findall("(?=%s)"%rxr,nuc))
    pc="".join(P.seq)
    op=len(re.findall("(?=%s)"%rxf,pc))+len(re.findall("(?=%s)"%rxr,pc))
    p=sum(p_markov3(w) for w in expand(m))
    eg=2*(len(nuc)-len(m)+1)*p; ep=2*(len(pc)-len(m)+1)*p
    nprom=P.seq.map(lambda s: bool(re.search(rxf,s) or re.search(rxr,s))).sum()
    return dict(motif=m,len=len(m),genome_obs=og,genome_exp_M3=round(eg,1),obs_over_exp=round(og/eg,2) if eg else np.nan,
                prom_obs=op,prom_exp_M3=round(ep,1),prom_obs_over_exp=round(op/ep,2) if ep else np.nan,
                promoters_with_site=int(nprom),pct_promoters=round(100*nprom/len(P),1))

TESTS={
 "Gcn4 (positive control, PMID 2185476 consensus)":"TGACTCA",
 "Rap1 (positive control)":"RMACCCANNCAYY",
 "Mcm1/P-box (positive control)":"TTWCCNAAWNNGGWAA",
 "Ste12 PRE (positive control)":"TGAAACA",
 "WOPR 5 bp crystal core":"GTTTA",
 "WOPR 7 bp":"AGTTTAA",
 "WOPR 8 bp":"AAGTTTAA",
 "WOPR chemistry-only (1 G:C + A/T tract)":"GWWWW",
}
rows=[]
for lab,m in TESTS.items():
    r=scan(m); r["label"]=lab; rows.append(r)
C=pd.DataFrame(rows)[["label","motif","len","genome_obs","genome_exp_M3","obs_over_exp","promoters_with_site","pct_promoters"]]
print("=== POSITIVE-CONTROL COMPARISON: same pipeline, known yeast motifs vs the WOPR consensus ===")
print(C.to_string(index=False))
C.to_csv("positive_control_motif_comparison.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5))
col=["#1e8449" if "positive control" in l else "#c0392b" for l in C.label]
ax.barh(range(len(C)),C.obs_over_exp,color=col)
ax.axvline(1,ls="--",color="black",lw=1)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(C))); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{m}" for m in C.motif],fontsize=9)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlabel("observed / expected in the nuclear genome (3rd-order Markov background)")
ax.set_title("Known yeast TF sites are enriched; the WOPR crystal site is at chance\n(green = established motif, red = WOPR structure-derived)")
for i,(v,n) in enumerate(zip(C.obs_over_exp,C.pct_promoters)):
    ax.text(v+0.03,i,f"{v:.2f}  ({n}% of promoters)",va="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0,max(C.obs_over_exp)*1.45)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nartifacts:",sorted(f for f in os.listdir(".") if f.endswith(".csv")))
